manual_visual_review.method: All current endpoint sheets and forty sampled motion frames per chapter inspected, Reviewed sheet hashes must match the final artifacts.
focused_repairs: Hypothetical DVOL-proxy dollar-option examples; HAR entry-date leakage and half-day Surface quote timing prohibit executable-edge claims
Taylor and continuous-hedge assumptions; log-contract weights; unadjusted 25-delta call/put signs; local RR/BF interpretation
Kelly quadratic uses the second moment; overlapping sample optimum near observed bankruptcy wall gives no future bound
Fixed 24-trade Glosten--Milgrom sequence ends at posterior 0.5; final bid/ask recomputed from final belief
Dollar-converted signed markout formula; changing horizon cohorts; no identification of informed traders from markouts alone
Finite recorded histogram and replay ranges, all 66 predictions and all five bootstrap refits retained
Fixed hedge rules and held-out learner cohorts distinguished; three seeds only at kappa=1; GLFT is a long-horizon approximation
Early cash-dividend exercise tie and put-spread liability bound; pinning grid proxy and own-peak histogram scaling
Selected-Q mean-variance illustration versus finite empirical exponential tilt with a fixed hedge; positive liability residual skewness
Worked dollar versus IV cross-impact answer; baseline curves, near-money rows and first research-direction card shown promptly
SEC historical fund cases, SEBI allegations and current legal record, OCC options-and-futures count and COR3M backcast qualification
Short-dated tickets treat each record as one unit, ignoring trade size; instrument returns are distinct from seller P&L
Duplicate post-camera timed fades removed across seven 3D stages after a1.5-second blank was observed in Scalp
Initial SecondOrder and Early formula writes shortened to show explanatory notes sooner; gamma display scale and cap disclosed in both languages
Missing Mandarin captions and narration repaired; camera orbits bounded before a steady view

audio_note: Signal and token-time checks do not certify pronunciation or continuous listening. Kokoro technical-line warnings remain a listening lead; Mandarin within-sentence character times are estimated.

manual_review.review: All32 fresh sampled narrated frames visually inspected; readable settled states and transitions, no observed overlap or cropping. Current narration raw text matches the final English endpoint receipt.
